changeSet.comment: A deployment that already seeded the seven stage switches and whose administrator then switched one stage off. The rows themselves are not inserted here: changeset 036 has run by this boundary, so the only existing data an upgrade has to preserve is the administrator's own choice.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE clinlims.site_information SET value = 'false' WHERE name = 'pathology.stage.COVERSLIPPING.enabled';
